name_zh: 海地·杜瓦利埃：医生独裁与通顿马库特伏都恐怖贫困
name_en: Haiti Duvalier: Doctor Dictatorship & Tonton Macoute Voodoo Terror Poverty
description_zh: 弗朗索瓦·杜瓦利埃 (1907-1971) 海地总统 (1957-1971)，医生出身建立通顿马库特恐怖秘警，伏都教政治化巩固统治，女儿继任让-克洛德延续恐怖，国家陷入极度贫困灾难。
description_en: Francois Duvalier (1907-1971) Haiti President (1957-1971), doctor origin established Tonton Macoute terror secret police, Voodoo politicization consolidated rule, son Jean-Claude continued terror, nation plunged into extreme poverty disaster.
reason_zh: 杜瓦利埃代表医生如何异化为恐怖独裁者，展示了伏都教如何被政治化为统治工具，通顿马库特成为国家恐怖机器代名词，海地从加勒比明珠沦为西半球最贫困国家。
reason_en: Duvalier represents how doctor mutates into terror dictator, demonstrating how Voodoo politicized as ruling tool, Tonton Macoute becoming state terror machine synonym, Haiti from Caribbean pearl fell to Western Hemisphere poorest nation.
steps_zh: 研究杜瓦利埃早年医生与美国公共卫生项目经历
分析1957年选举上台与通顿马库特恐怖机器建立
探讨伏都教政治化与巴龙·萨梅迪个人崇拜融合
评估女儿让-克洛德继任与1986年民众起义下台
总结医生独裁通顿马库特伏都恐怖贫困对海地发展的毁灭性遗产
steps_en: Study Duvalier early doctor and US public health project experience
Analyze 1957 election accession and Tonton Macoute terror machine establishment
Explore Voodoo politicization and Baron Samedi personality cult fusion
Evaluate son Jean-Claude succession and 1986 popular uprising ousting
Summarize doctor dictatorship Tonton Macoute Voodoo terror poverty destructive legacy for Haiti development
expected_zh: 理解专业知识如何被扭曲为恐怖统治工具，掌握宗教政治化如何在脆弱国家构建个人崇拜恐怖机制，评估杜瓦利埃遗产对海地长期不稳定与贫困陷阱的根源责任。
expected_en: Understand how professional knowledge distorts into terror ruling tool, grasp how religion politicization builds personality cult terror mechanism in fragile state, evaluate Duvalier legacy root responsibility for Haiti chronic instability and poverty trap.
case_zh: 1957 总统；通顿马库特；伏都恐怖；1971 逝世。医生独裁通顿伏都恐怖贫困范式永存。
case_en: 1957 President; Tonton Macoute; Voodoo terror; 1971 death. Doctor dictatorship Tonton Voodoo terror poverty paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Doctor dictator; Tonton Macoute; Voodoo terror; Haiti poverty
